page.layout: One printed page, title page. Full-width title block at top, centred; below it a copperplate engraving with the caption "DEO GUBERNANTE" on the ship; below the engraving the imprint centred. No margin text.

main_text.l: Doctrinam Veritatis, quæ secundum pietatem est,
eámque contra quoscunque Adversarios, Veteres & Novos,
vel in Fundamento fidei, vel circa illud errantes, ita asserens,
ut simul Historiæ Ecclesiasticæ V. & N.T. contineat Ἀλη-τύπωσιν,

page.notes: The engraving shows a ship at sea steered by a hand emerging from clouds, with rays from a sun bearing a triangle; the caption "DEO GUBERNANTE" runs along the rays. The Greek word in the imprint line "Ἀλη-τύπωσιν" is a reading of a small Greek word that may be imperfect; the printed word is possibly "Ἀληθύπωσιν" or similar and is uncertain. The top of the page has a water stain and tear; no words are lost.
